description: Records a monthly or yearly spending ceiling, in cents, for one of the user's projects by project_id. For when the user states a spending limit. It never authorises a purchase and cannot spend money. The response includes the project's current carry and headroom. Headroom is flagged partial when a domain's renewal price is unknown: an unknown renewal is counted as unknown, never as zero, so headroom is then an upper bound. PRICES ARE IDENTICAL FOR ALL BUYERS REGARDLESS OF BUDGET. A budget changes what is recommended and how results are ordered; it never changes what anything costs.
name: set_budget
